progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk4 and dwells most on Bb in Zabol. The line peaks at Gk4 (385.7 Hz) at 1:13.6. It closes on the tonic (Eb4 → Gk4 → Eb4 → Ab3 → Gk4 → Gk3).
